items.title: OpenESM: Energy-Steered Models Are Scalable Foundation Learners
items.summary: arXiv:2610.33005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Energy-based models have shown promising properties for domain-specific tasks but remain challenging in modeling general-purpose scenarios. To bridge this gap, we design energy-steered models (ESMs) for foundational language modeling. ESMs integrate energy steering and token generation within a single architecture to leverage the energy-guided search to refine token generation. Specifically, ESMs first optimize a latent state over the energy landsc
items.summary_zh: OpenESM 将能量引导搜索与 Token 生成集成在单一架构中，通过能量引导机制提升大语言模型在通用场景下的建模能力。
items.why_zh: 属于生成式模型架构优化，可学习如何利用能量函数（Energy-based models）作为引导策略，提升模型在复杂推理任务中的搜索效率。

items.title: Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding
items.summary: arXiv:2610.33006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) impose substantial computation and memory costs as context sizes increase, motivating methods that compress a context into a shorter representation before inference. Existing soft-prompt compression methods typically use the same Transformer backbone as used in the target model, where producing the compressed representation leads to significant latency overheads. This restricts them to the offline sett
items.summary_zh: 提出一种基于状态空间编码（State-Space Encoding）的线性时间上下文压缩方法，旨在降低 Transformer 模型在长上下文下的计算与内存开销。
items.why_zh: 属于长上下文处理优化，可学习如何通过状态空间模型（SSM）替代或辅助 Transformer 实现高效的上下文压缩与信息蒸馏。

items.title: IRON-Meme: A Benchmark for Structured Understanding of Identities and Roles in Online Meme Narratives
items.summary: arXiv:2610.33097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As polarization grows on social media, understanding how political memes shape online narratives has become increasingly important. Previous research has relied on either qualitative frameworks that are hard to scale or computational methods that lack theoretical grounding. Both approaches treat narrative categories in isolation and focus exclusively on moral portrayals of identity. To address these limitations, we introduce a framework grounded in
items.summary_zh: IRON-Meme 基准测试集用于评估模型对在线模因（Meme）中身份与角色的结构化理解能力，填补了政治叙事分析的理论空白。
items.why_zh: 属于多模态语义理解与社会计算，可学习如何构建结构化标注数据集，以提升 Agent 对非结构化社交媒体内容中隐含意图的识别能力。

items.title: HarnessRouter/harnessrouter
items.summary: HarnessRouter Community Edition: the self-hosted, Apache-2.0 edition of the unified interface for agent harnesses. Run Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, PI, DSH, and more through one API, with sessions, streaming, files, cancellation, and failure handling. Implements the Unified Harness Protocol (UHP), an open standard. Your keys, your infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: HarnessRouter 提供统一的 Agent 接口协议（UHP），支持自托管运行 Codex、Claude Code 等多种 Agent 框架，实现会话、流式传输及故障处理的标准化。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 基础设施工程，可学习如何设计统一的 API 抽象层来解耦底层 Agent 实现，提升多 Agent 系统集成的可维护性与可移植性。

items.title: NVlabs/SoL-Pi
items.summary: SoL-Pi: Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harnesses
items.summary_zh: SoL-Pi 专注于扩展自动化研究循环（Auto-Research Loops），旨在为 Agent 框架提供高效的自动化研究与任务执行能力。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 自主循环控制，可学习如何构建闭环的自动化研究流程，优化 Agent 在长链路任务中的自我迭代与信息检索效率。

items.title: shuyu-labs/transwork
items.summary: 企业级桌面 AI Agent 工作台，让技能、知识与任务在同一处协作。
items.summary_zh: Transwork 是一个企业级桌面 AI Agent 工作台，旨在实现技能、知识库与任务流程的统一协作与管理。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 应用层架构，可学习如何设计桌面端 Agent 的人机交互界面（HCI）以及如何整合企业级知识库与工作流引擎。

items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型，提供针对特定任务优化的 API 接口与性能基准。
items.why_zh: 模型架构演进与 API 迭代；学习如何利用新模型特性进行 Prompt 工程优化及推理成本控制。

items.title: How to Build Agents That Improve Over Time: Model, Harness, Context | Interrupt London
items.summary: Harrison Chase, Co-Founder and CEO of LangChain, splits an agent into three parts, the model, the harness, and the context, and explains how each one can improve over time: the model's weights through supervised fine-tuning with LangSmith Fine-Tuning and its smithtune CLI, or through RL for more complex tasks; the harness through LangSmith Engine, a deep agent that runs over traces, clusters issues, and proposes fixes with a human in the loop; and the context through memory, where he points to H…
items.summary_zh: LangChain CEO 提出将 Agent 拆解为 Model、Harness 和 Context 三部分，并通过 LangSmith 进行持续迭代优化。
items.why_zh: Agent 系统架构设计；掌握通过 SFT 和 RL 闭环优化 Agent 性能的工程化落地路径。

items.title: patch-gg/anymove
items.summary: Motion capture for any creature from one AI video: two cameras in one frame, a DINOv2 joint reader, the rig fitted in both views, a GLB out.
items.summary_zh: anymove 利用 DINOv2 视觉模型从单段视频中提取多视角关节数据，实现跨物种动作捕捉并输出 GLB 模型。
items.why_zh: 计算机视觉与 3D 建模；学习利用预训练视觉模型进行特征提取与跨模态数据转换的实现方案。

items.title: How We Built Our Design Agent
items.summary: How LangChain built Content Studio, an open-source design agent in Slack that makes on-brand videos, graphics and decks, and the harness that powers it.
items.summary_zh: LangChain 分享 Content Studio 设计 Agent 的构建过程，展示了如何通过 Slack 交互实现自动化品牌内容生成。
items.why_zh: 多模态 Agent 开发；学习如何构建具备业务逻辑约束与人机交互界面的生产级 Agent 系统。

items.title: webframe: evaluated as a scraper and a sandbox
items.summary: Research: webframe: evaluated as a scraper and a sandbox webframe is a neat little project from Jeff Lindsay which lets you "run a web page like a program" - you point it at a URL or file and it executes it in a hidden headless web view and outputs console.log() to standard output and any exceptions to standard error. It's written in Go on top of the glaze library, which provides access to a system browser ("WKWebView on macOS, WebKitGTK on Linux, WebView2 on Windows") so it doesn't need to bund…
items.summary_zh: webframe 项目通过 Go 语言封装 headless web view，将网页转化为可执行程序并捕获其控制台输出与异常。
items.why_zh: Web 自动化与沙箱技术；学习如何构建轻量级网页执行环境以实现高效的数据抓取与程序化控制。

items.title: Run Your AI Software Factory Like a Real Engineering Org (Here's How)
items.summary: A software factory is a system that moves work through the software development lifecycle (SDLC) using repeatable, agent-driven workflows, with context, guardrails, and human approval built in. As teams scale AI-driven development, a software factory needs a wrapper that provides context, observability, and control. In this video, I walk through how I scale my own software factory with Port, covering the agent and skill registry, the context lake, repository scorecards, and self-improving workfl…
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 软件工厂概念，通过 Agent 驱动的工作流、上下文管理与人工审核机制实现软件开发生命周期的自动化。
items.why_zh: AI 工程化管理；学习如何构建具备可观测性、护栏机制与人机协作的规模化 AI 开发流水线。

items.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
items.summary: Meet Genie 4, Google DeepMind’s most realistic and interactive world model yet. Built on our Gemini models, Genie 4 lets you step inside dynamic worlds in real time, steer scenes on the fly with natural language, and watch what happens next: how the world responds, how it sounds, and how the people in it move, react, and speak. We have started rolling out Genie 4 as a research preview for trusted testers, and it's coming soon to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partn…
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4，基于 Gemini 构建的交互式世界模型，支持通过自然语言实时生成并操控动态场景，实现视觉、听觉及角色行为的同步响应。
items.why_zh: 属于生成式世界模型领域，可学习如何利用多模态大模型进行复杂环境建模与实时交互控制，适用于构建高保真仿真环境。

items.title: vLLM Semantic Router Releases d3-ultra: A 27B Open Multimodal Decision Model
items.summary: vLLM Semantic Router released d3-ultra, a 27B open-weight multimodal decision model. It reads text, images and video once, then returns probabilities for every answer, scoring 87.2 on the team’s SR-Text test. The post vLLM Semantic Router Releases d3-ultra: A 27B Open Multimodal Decision Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: vLLM Semantic Router 发布 d3-ultra，一款 27B 参数的开源多模态决策模型，支持文本、图像和视频的单次输入处理，并在 SR-Text 基准测试中表现优异。
items.why_zh: 属于多模态决策与推理优化领域，可学习如何通过统一架构处理多种模态输入并输出决策概率，适用于构建高效的端到端智能决策系统。

dups.title: youngyangyang04/llm-master
dups.summary: 大模型（LLM）全栈学习路线与中文教程🔥：覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、AI Agent、MCP、微调、模型部署、Transformer、AI 编程与大厂面试，从入门到生产实践。
dups.summary_zh: 提供覆盖 Prompt Engineering 到模型部署等全栈 LLM 学习路线的中文教程。
dups.why_zh: 对 AI 工程师系统掌握 LLM 技术栈和面试准备极具参考价值。

dups.title: PaperPilot – Zero-Cloud, Pure-Rust PDF Engine with WASM and MCP
dups.summary_zh: PaperPilot 是一个基于纯 Rust 开发的 PDF 引擎，支持 WASM 和 MCP 协议，旨在提供高性能、零云端的文档处理能力。
dups.why_zh: 属于高性能计算与 Agent 工具集成领域，可学习如何通过 WASM 实现跨平台轻量级工具部署，以及如何将本地引擎封装为 MCP Server。

dups.title: Fazmin/AILearningGuide
dups.summary: Interactive desktop app with 51 labs covering ML fundamentals, transformers, RAG, agents, fine-tuning and quantization and more.
dups.summary_zh: 提供交互式桌面应用，包含51个实验涵盖机器学习基础、Transformer、RAG、Agent、微调与量化等内容。
dups.why_zh: 可学习动手实验的组织方式，掌握从基础到高级模型的全流程实践，适合面试中展示系统化学习能力。

dups.title: Folkbench/folkbench
dups.summary: AI API 中转站评测排行与切换工具：实测可用率、延迟与价格 · Open-source AI API relay benchmark, rankings & switcher for Claude Code / Codex
dups.summary_zh: 开源 Rust 工具 Folkbench，提供 AI API 中转站评测排行与切换功能，实测 Claude Code 等兼容性。
dups.why_zh: 涉及 LLM 基础设施开发与性能基准测试，学习如何构建多 API 路由代理及监控可用性与延迟。

dups.title: tangency-labs/solidcraft
dups.summary: SolidCraft: an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Desktop, web, and automation through MCP.
dups.summary_zh: SolidCraft 是用纯 Rust 构建的开源参数化3D CAD 应用，支持桌面、网页及MCP自动化。
dups.why_zh: 演示Rust在复杂图形系统中的工程实践，可参考高性能跨平台CAD开发。

dups.title: rehan-remade/universal-modder
dups.summary: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
dups.summary_zh: 使用 Claude Code 及 fal MCP 进行游戏逆向、资产生成、测试等全流程 MOD 制作。
dups.why_zh: 表明大模型可直接参与游戏逆向与内容创作，为工程师提供新范式。
